 Who we are? 
 Do you need customer service help? Are you looking for a company to call and find out more information
 about the services they offer, like their address or phone number? If so, then

 around since 2012 and currently offers up-to-date contact information from over 10 million

 What is customer service?
 Customer service is defined as the provision of service to customers before, during, and after a
 purchase.
 It includes everything from answering questions about a product or service to initiating complaints or
 resolving disputes with a company. Customer service is sometimes referred to as CS (short for customer
 service), client services, buyer services, and account management.
 Why is customer service important for business?
 Although customer service is often thought of as the provision of service to customers, it's also
 about satisfying needs and wants. That goes beyond just providing good products and services.
 Providing good customer service requires businesses to provide the information that helps their
 customers meet both their business and personal goals, which in turn builds brand loyalty.
 Benefits of good customer service
 Good customer service is a great chance to see firsthand what your customers are thinking. It's an
 effective way to provide prompt feedback on the operation of products and services, as well as
 getting ideas for future improvements.
 Good customer service can help you win new business by developing a loyal clientele. Customers who
 receive good customer care are more likely to become repeat customers or recommend you to others who
 have needs similar to theirs.
 Good customer service also creates trust between the business and its existing and potential
 clientele. When people feel that they're valued, they tend to remain loyal—and that means they'll
 keep coming back for more products or services through word-of-mouth referrals.
 If you take advantage of outsourcing opportunities, good customer service can also lead to overall
 cost savings.
 Tips for better customer service
 The best advice for creating and maintaining a quality customer service experience is to focus on
 customer satisfaction. There are a number of ways you can do this, but first, you have to
 understand the needs and wants of your customers.
 To create an effective approach to customer service, determine what methods work best for your
 organization. Keep in mind that every business is different, so don't assume that implementing one
 particular strategy will automatically benefit your company—and even if it works well for another
 business, that doesn't mean it will provide the same results for yours.
 Here are some approaches that other companies have used successfully:
 Flexibility: If possible, try offering flexible hours or alternative contact methods, such as email
 or online chat features on your website. More flexibility allows customers greater control over how
 they interact with different types of support services, which, in turn, makes it possible to assess
 the direction that needs to be optimized as much as possible.
 Online Communities: Provide interactive forums or even live chat with community managers or
 moderators. The idea here is to create a more social relationship with the customer, which can
 provide all kinds of benefits, including faster responses to questions and greater loyalty in
 general.
 Customer Service-Only Departments: Some companies completely separate their customer service
 departments from other areas, such as sales or marketing. This has proven especially effective for
 tech companies that frequently experience high volumes of calls and emails related to similar
 issues. Although this might require a different type of training than what's used in other parts of
 the organization, it could prove worthwhile if your customers place a higher value on personalized
 assistance from professionals who know how to handle your product or service specifically.
 New Approaches: You can always come up with new approaches and methods to support customers. For
 example, you can develop a web-based video library where customers can search for answers to common
 questions using keywords. Or perhaps your company could run a free monthly seminar via WebEx or some
 other online platform that would provide training and answer frequently asked questions.
 In addition to saving time, it's estimated that service automation tools eliminate the need to hire
 additional support staff, which also saves companies money. So companies should consider investing
 in a CRM system that provides easy access to customer information and allows agents to use
 self-service options since this may eventually result in reduced costs and happier customers.
